newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil hosts international airport fair.
newsitem.headline: Brazil hosts international airport fair.

text.p: Brazil will open its first bi-annual International Airport Fair on November 20 in which local and international exhibitors will present their latest products and technology developments.
The four-day seminar, which is sponsored by Brazil's airport agency Infraero, will take place in Campinas, 62 miles (99 kms) Northeast of Sao Paulo.
Participants include Transport Canada, Hartsfield International Airport, Luftansa and San Franciso International Airport. -- Romina Nicaretta, Sao Paulo newsroom, 5511 248 5415.
